definitions: To experience the same unpleasant treatment that one has given to others.
To be treated in the same way you have treated others, especially in a negative sense.
examples: After years of pranking his friends, he finally got a taste of his own medicine.
She was always critical of others, and now she's getting a taste of her own medicine.
The bully got a taste of his own medicine when the new kid stood up to him.
lemma: to get a taste of one's own medicine
synonyms: to be hoisted by one's own petard
source: to get a taste of your own medicine
